caption: The drawing consists of two outlined shoe-like objects placed side by side on a plain, uncolored background. The left object is a simple outline of a shoe viewed from the top, featuring a rounded toe, narrow heel, and an inner curved outline suggesting the insole. The right object is a more detailed outline of a lace-up shoe, also viewed from the top, depicting details such as the opening, tongue, eyestays, seven lace holes on each side, crisscrossed laces, and one lace extending outward to the right. The lines of the drawing are thin and black, and the entirety of the drawing is set on a sheet of off-white paper with slight discoloration and a few small spots.
title: Baby Shoe
